---
# ! HOW TO USE: copy and paste this template into your folder (lastname-firstname) and rename it into `index.qmd`. Then, complete the fiels and remove all comments.
title: Full name
description: Roles
# use a square photo (same width and height) so it displays consistently with everyone else's card, with no empty margins or cropping
image: avatar.webp

last: Last name
first: First name
email: Your email of contact

# select one of the following groups. introduce it as a string (surrounded by ""), as this allow to perform glob operations.
people_group: "pi | research_scientist | postdoc | visitor | phd | student | alumni"
# the moment you started in the group (just for card order).
member-since: YYYY-MM
# institution shows as a small badge on your card, so it's clear at a glance where you're based. bold whichever one you're physically based at, eg. "<strong>UPV</strong>-CSIC" for someone physically at UPV but also in CSIC.
institution: "<strong>UPV</strong>"
# your thesis directors. if none, remove it. you can use html to link your directors to its web page as seen in the placeholder. list every director equally, without distinguishing director from co-director.
thesis_directors: "<a href='../tarazona-sonia/index.qmd'>Sonia Tarazona</a>; Nombre1 Apellido1, Nombre2 Apellido2 & Nombre3 Apellido3"

# education is shown as a HTML list where each title is an element of the list. the education title follows the structure "<PhD|MS|BS> in <X> | University <X> (<year>)". this same list is also reused automatically to build the short version shown on your compact card in the group listing, so you only need to fill it in once here.
# just modify the following template with your data
education: |
  <ul>
    <li><strong>PhD in Statistics</strong> | Universitat Politècnica de València (2014)</li>
    <li><strong>BS in Mathematics & Statistics</strong> | Universitat Politècnica de València (2001)</li>
  </ul>


# we use the "trestles" template for the "about" div. 
about:
  id: hero-heading
  template: trestles
  image-shape: round

  # remove the links fields that are unnecessary
  links: 
    - icon: envelope-fill
      href: mailto:example@email.com

    - icon: globe2
      href: https://www.example-website.com
    
    - icon: linkedin
      href: https://www.linkedin.com/in/example-profile.com
    
    - icon: github
      href: https://github.com/example-profile.com
    
    - text: '<i class="ai ai-google-scholar-square"></i>'
      href: https://github.com/example-scholar.com
    
    - text: '<i class="ai ai-orcid"></i>'
      href: https://orcid.org/example-orcid.com

page-layout: full
---
